reference.comparison_scope: Broad visible adult appearance traits only: long near-black wavy hair, warm brown eyes, softly arched brows, an oval face, and natural rose lips.

scoring_policy.target_gate_policy: Every target gate is hard. Any partial, ambiguous, hidden, or merely implied realization counts as a failure.
scoring_policy.inspection_rule: Judge only what is visibly present in the rendered image; do not use prompt wording as evidence.
scoring_policy.overall_pass_rule: Pass only if every target gate, every confound rejection gate, and every common photo/reference gate passes.

target_gates.observable_pass_condition: A large glass-cased astronomical clock is a clearly readable scene centerpiece, with concentric numbered time dials and a distinct moon-phase disk visible together.
The main apparatus visibly exposes intermeshing brass gears, a coiled mainspring, and a recognizable escapement or balance assembly as connected parts of one mechanism.
The adult woman’s hand clearly grips an oversized brass winding key that is visibly inserted into the astronomical clock, making the winding action and physical contact unambiguous.
A palm-sized enamel mechanical bird is visibly emerging from an opened escapement cage on the clock while the wound mechanism is moving, so it reads as the immediate consequence of the key turn.

The surrounding time-tower workshop visibly extends the clockwork system through a wall-sized gear train, suspended pocket watches, and horological calibration tools, making timekeeping machinery—not surface decoration—the dominant world-building language.

nearest_neighbor_rejection_gates.reject_if: The image reads primarily as steampunk because boilers, steam plumes, pressure gauges, or pipework dominate while clock faces, mainspring, escapement, and winding mechanism are absent or secondary.

The image reads as a generic antique clock shop, luxury-watch fashion portrait, or gear-pattern costume because the woman merely poses beside clocks and no visible winding action produces a mechanical consequence.

common_photo_reference_gates.observable_pass_condition: Exactly one unmistakably adult woman is the principal human subject; her face is unobscured and her body proportions do not read as juvenile.

Compared only at the level of broad visible appearance, the subject shows long near-black wavy hair, warm brown eyes, softly arched brows, an oval face, and natural rose lips; this is an appearance comparison, not an identity judgment.

The face, winding hand, inserted key, glass clock case, and meshing machinery are photographically coherent in one frame, with no duplicated limbs, malformed fingers, fused hand-key contact, impossible gear intersections, or contradictory perspective.
